title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain DePauw University
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with directly verified current evening availability in or at DePauw University’s Greencastle campus community.

cards.title: Hoover Hall Late Night
cards.subtitle: DePauw University campus
cards.notes: Use the documented 9:00–11:30 p.m. Late Night service for a campus food option; check the dining page for the rotating evening concept.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw states that Late Night is available at Hoover Hall every evening from 9:00 p.m. to 11:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Directly listed as available every evening, 9:00 p.m.–11:30 p.m.; offerings rotate.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Indianapolis Road
cards.subtitle: 1152 Indianapolis Rd, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: For the latest listed option, use the drive-thru hours: it runs to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option with the board’s latest verified hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Greencastle location lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 1152 Indianapolis Rd, Greencastle
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Sun–Thu and 9:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in hours are listed separately.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Indianapolis Road
cards.subtitle: 1018 Indianapolis Rd, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: This location’s restaurant and drive-thru both list a midnight close daily; confirm holiday exceptions before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A daily midnight food stop on the Indianapolis Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours at 1018 Indianapolis Road as 6:30 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru both list 6:30 a.m.–12:00 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Marvin’s on College Avenue
cards.subtitle: 202 S College Ave, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: Plan around the posted evening schedule: Friday and Saturday service runs until midnight, while other listed dinner nights end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A near-campus restaurant with verified Friday and Saturday midnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Marvin’s lists Friday hours of 5:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m. and Saturday hours of 5:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday evening service ends at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Casey’s on South Bloomington Street
cards.subtitle: 1215 S Bloomington St, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: Use the store for late convenience items, or place a pizza pickup order before its separately listed 10:30 p.m. pickup cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A late-open convenience store with pizza pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey’s lists this Greencastle store as open 4:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily, with pickup available until 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are 4:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily; pickup and delivery are listed until 10:30 p.m.

cards.title: Don Julio on Franklin Street
cards.subtitle: 11 W Franklin St, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: For a downtown dinner that extends later on weekends, use the posted Friday and Saturday 10:00 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Franklin Street restaurant with weekend service to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Don Julio lists hours until 10:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday at 11 West Franklin Street.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday; 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Monical’s Pizza at Putnam Plaza
cards.subtitle: 29 Putnam Plz, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: Use the directly posted Friday and Saturday schedule when planning a later pizza pickup or delivery; delivery has the same listed close.
cards.short_summary: A Putnam Plaza pizza option that runs to 10 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Monical’s Pizza of Greencastle lists Friday and Saturday location and delivery hours until 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Location and delivery are listed until 10:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday close at 9:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Subway at The Shoppes of Greencastle
cards.title: Subway at The Shoppes of Greencastle
cards.subtitle: 1360 Indianapolis Rd, Suite A, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: This sandwich stop lists 10:00 p.m. closing every day; use the location page to check ordering or service details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A daily 10 p.m. sandwich option on Indianapolis Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway lists its The Shoppes of Greencastle location at 1360 Indianapolis Road as open 9:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 9:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Dairy Castle on Indianapolis Road
cards.subtitle: 801 Indianapolis Rd, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page’s evening hours for a food or ice-cream stop; Sunday is listed later than the Tuesday–Saturday schedule.
cards.short_summary: An Indianapolis Road food and ice-cream stop open into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Castle lists hours until 9:30 p.m. Sunday and until 9:00 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sunday 10:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; Tuesday–Saturday 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: The Putnam Inn on North Jackson Street
cards.subtitle: 400 N Jackson St, Greencastle, IN
cards.notes: For an early-evening meal, use the posted Tuesday–Saturday schedule and arrive with time to spare before the 9:00 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A North Jackson Street restaurant with dinner service to 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Putnam Inn lists Tuesday through Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday; the restaurant is listed closed Sunday and Monday.
